variants.prompt: In the opulent penthouse suite of a luxurious LA high-rise, a striking young woman with fiery red hair and bright green eyes, clad in a black leather bodysuit that highlights her toned physique, strikes a confident pose by the floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the glittering cityscape, the late afternoon sunlight casting dramatic shadows on her skin as the camera frames her in a full body shot with a wide aperture to create a creamy bokeh.
